free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the convergence of high-risk imaging and aggressive biochemical changes. The PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right anterior mid-gland is a decisive factor, strongly supported by a rapid PSA velocity of 3.33 ng/mL/yr and a significant PSA trend from 2.8 ng/mL to 16.8 ng/mL. The statistical prior was overturned by the retrieved evidence showing this trajectory, making sampling necessary to assess the lesion.
